about: Tricky strings that travel up Kyber's socket as event values. hud/Tests/KyberKitTests/EventFixtureTests.swift checks Swift emits exactly row_line and send_line for each (HUD_FIXTURE_RECORD=1 rewrites them); tests/test_hud_events.py checks every Python reader recovers value, and surface, from those same lines. A row id or a typed message must never become a second key or a second line.

cases.name: plain graph id
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="thread:abc123"

cases.name: spaces
cases.row_line: e action reply row="thread with spaces" surface="messages"
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="thread with spaces"

cases.name: quote then a fake key
cases.row_line: e action reply row="a\" surface=\"evil" surface="messages"
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="a\" surface=\"evil"

cases.name: a fake key with no quote
cases.row_line: e action reply row="x surface=evil" surface="messages"
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="x surface=evil"

cases.name: a second row
cases.row_line: e action reply row="x row=y" surface="messages"
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="x row=y"

cases.name: escaped quote and backslash
cases.row_line: e action reply row="a\\\" surface=\\\"evil" surface="messages"
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="a\\\" surface=\\\"evil"

cases.name: newline then a forged event
cases.row_line: e action reply row="a\ne action open row=\"x\" surface=\"rail\"" surface="messages"
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="a\ne action open row=\"x\" surface=\"rail\""
cases.value:
a
e action open row="x" surface="rail"

cases.name: carriage return
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="a\r\nsurface=evil"

cases.name: line separator U+2028
cases.row_line: e action reply row="a\u2028e closed sessions" surface="messages"
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="a\u2028e closed sessions"

cases.name: paragraph separator U+2029
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="a\u2029b"

cases.name: next line U+0085
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="a\u0085b"

cases.name: tab
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="a\tb"

cases.name: empty
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text=""

cases.name: leading and trailing spaces
cases.row_line: e action reply row="  padded  " surface="messages"
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="  padded  "

cases.name: equals signs
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="a=b==c"

cases.name: slash and colon
cases.row_line: e action reply row="path:\/Users\/x\/a b.swift" surface="messages"
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="path:\/Users\/x\/a b.swift"

cases.name: json lookalike
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="{\"surface\":\"evil\",\"row\":\"x\"}"

cases.name: accented
cases.row_line: e action reply row="café résumé" surface="messages"
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="café résumé"

cases.name: control character
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="a\u0001b"

cases.name: word true
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="true"

cases.name: number-looking
cases.send_line: e action send row="s-abc" surface="s-abc" text="42"
